off = not homed by $H, neg or pos = the seek direction ($23 bit)
1.. sequence in the homing cycle, ascending
mm/min this axis's homing seek; 0 = home.seek

ms before stepper-enable drops after idle, 255 = always on ($1)
0/1 invert stepper-enable: 0 = active low, the usual driver EN, 1 = active high ($4)
ms a switch must stay triggered to count ($26); each ms is travel past the switch, below 3 gains nothing
times the axis travel the first seek looks for the switch before ALARM:9; 1.5 is usual
locate passes after the seek: each backs off and locates again at the locate feed, the last contact is the reference; 1 is usual
* 0/1 start in ALARM until every homing axis is homed, when home.enable is 1
times the deceleration of the seek's trigger stop: accel times n, jerk times n squared; 0 = off; 1.5 to 2 is realistic; seek only
0/1 square a twin-motor axis on $H; needs a y2 or z2 role and a second switch
mm solo-travel bound while squaring; 0 = 5% of travel, held to 2.5..25 mm
mm signed trim of the twin after squaring
0/1 check every motion target against each axis's travel window, set from axis.X.homepos; needs home.enable ($20)
a target outside the window: alarm = brake to rest, then ALARM:2, position kept; refuse = the line is refused before any motion, no alarm
0/1 a limit switch stops the machine and alarms ($21)
0/1 invert the limit switches: 0 = active low, 1 = active high ($5)
0 = stop the pulses at once, then alarm; 1 = brake to rest, then alarm, position kept
0/1 invert the probe: 0 = active low, 1 = active high ($6)
ms a probe contact must stay made to count; each ms is travel past the contact
0/1 laser mode: the PWM follows S as the motion reaches it ($32)
ms to wait after the spindle starts (M3/M4, resume, door restore) before motion continues; 0 = none; not in laser mode
ms to wait after the spindle stops before motion continues; M3 to M4 is a spin-down then a spin-up; 0 = none
* mm arc chord tolerance for caPy's own G2/G3 flattening ($12)
* mm hybrid spline FIT bound -- shapes the speed profile, never the path
* mm the G-code was rounded to, 0.001 = 3 decimals, turns the smoothing fit on; 0 = exact input
* 0 = hybrid fitted-curve, 1 = cap2 polyline-exact, 2 = hybrid exact-path
* corner-arc tangent point as a fraction of the shorter leg: 0.5 = tightest, 1.0 = widest, the default
ms of motion pre-encoded ahead of real time in a program; 0 = uncapped; realtime commands reach the pins within this + 1 frame + about 150 ms
ms the same cover for a $J jog session: a jog change reaches the pins within this + about 4 ms

ms in $J jog mode a velocity lasts without a new V, U or T VX line for its axis, then it brakes to a stop and says so; resend while the stick is held; 0 = no message (the planner still brakes at 200 ms)
mm Z retract on safety door; 0 = hold without motion
bit0 1 = MPos 0 = WPos, bit1 = include Bf ($10)
* work coordinate system after a reset and after M2/M30
* units after a reset: G21 mm, G20 inch
* distance mode after a reset and after M2/M30
* arc plane after a reset and after M2/M30
* feed mode after a reset and after M2/M30: G94 units/min, G93 inverse time
0/1 write work offsets, G10 G28.1 G30.1, to flash at the first Idle; 0 = only by $save
** GPIO, -1 = none: first GPIO of the 16-pin STEP/DIR window, STEP and DIR for up to 7 motors plus accessories
** GPIO, -1 = none: spindle on/off, separate from the PWM
** GPIO, -1 = none: laser permit (hardware-timed: drops if the firmware stops)
** GPIO, -1 = none: X limit switch (sense: limit.invert)
** GPIO, -1 = none: X second switch (a squared twin)
** GPIO, -1 = none: Y second switch (a squared twin)
** GPIO, -1 = none: Z second switch (a squared twin)
** 0/1 invert the door input: 0 = active low, 1 = active high; active = open
** 0/1 invert the e-stop input: 0 = active low, 1 = active high; active = stop
** GPIO, -1 = none: button = 0x7E cycle start / resume
** 0/1 invert every button: 0 = active low, 1 = active high; active = pressed
ms a button must stay pressed to count
